properties.text: Node type must be None, LeafNode, ExtensionNode, or BranchNode; invalid types cause assertion failure.
properties.assertion: forall node: encode_internal_node(node) => node in {None, LeafNode, ExtensionNode, BranchNode}

properties.text: RLP encoding below 32 bytes returns unencoded form; 32+ bytes returns keccak256 hash.
properties.assertion: forall node: len(rlp.encode(node)) < 32 => returns unencoded; len >= 32 => returns keccak256(encoded)

properties.text: Account nodes require a non-None storage_root for encoding.
properties.assertion: forall node: isinstance(node, Account) => encode_node(node).storage_root is not None

properties.text: Unrecognized node types fall back to previous_trie.encode_node for backward compatibility.
properties.assertion: forall node: not isinstance(node, (Account,LegacyTx,Receipt,Withdrawal,U256,Bytes)) => previous_trie.encode_node(node)

properties.text: copy_trie performs shallow copy of _data; frozen objects are reused by reference.
properties.assertion: forall trie: copy_trie(trie)._data == copy.copy(trie._data) AND id(frozen_obj) preserved

properties.text: Default-valued keys are absent from trie._data; setting default deletes the key.
properties.assertion: forall trie,key: trie_set(trie,key,trie.default) => key not in trie._data

properties.text: trie_get returns trie.default for absent keys, never raises on missing keys.
properties.assertion: forall trie,key: key not in trie._data => trie_get(trie,key) == trie.default

properties.text: common_prefix_length returns value in [0, min(len(a), len(b))] with all prior elements equal.
properties.assertion: forall a,b: 0 <= common_prefix_length(a,b) <= min(len(a),len(b)) AND forall j<result: a[j]==b[j]

properties.text: All nibble values in input to nibble_list_to_compact must be in range [0, 15].
properties.assertion: forall x: nibble_list_to_compact(x) => forall n in x: 0 <= n <= 15

properties.text: Compact encoding first byte high nibble encodes is_leaf flag and parity correctly.
properties.assertion: forall x,is_leaf: compact[0]>>4 == 2*is_leaf + (len(x)%2)

properties.text: Compact encoding output length equals ceil((len(x) + 1) / 2).
properties.assertion: forall x: len(nibble_list_to_compact(x)) == ceil((len(x)+1)/2)

properties.text: bytes_to_nibble_list output length is exactly 2 * len(input) with each nibble in [0,15].
properties.assertion: forall b: len(bytes_to_nibble_list(b)) == 2*len(b) AND forall n in result: 0<=n<=15

properties.text: All encoded values in _prepare_trie output are non-empty; empty encoding causes assertion failure.
properties.assertion: forall trie: forall v in _prepare_trie(trie).values(): v != b''

properties.text: Secured tries hash keys with keccak256 before nibble conversion in _prepare_trie.
properties.assertion: forall trie: trie.secured => mapped_key == bytes_to_nibble_list(keccak256(preimage))

properties.text: Account values require non-None get_storage_root callback in _prepare_trie.
properties.assertion: forall trie: isinstance(v, Account) in trie._data => get_storage_root is not None

properties.text: Empty trie returns EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT (keccak256 of RLP-encoded empty string).
properties.assertion: forall trie: len(trie._data)==0 => root(trie)==keccak256(rlp.encode(b''))

properties.text: State root is always exactly 32 bytes regardless of trie content.
properties.assertion: forall trie: len(root(trie)) == 32

properties.text: Empty obj in patricialize always returns None node.
properties.assertion: forall obj: len(obj)==0 => patricialize(obj,level) == None

properties.text: Single-element obj in patricialize always produces LeafNode.
properties.assertion: forall obj: len(obj)==1 => isinstance(patricialize(obj,level), LeafNode)

properties.text: Account, Receipt, Uint must not appear at internal branch value positions in patricialize.
properties.assertion: forall obj,key: len(key)==level AND isinstance(obj[key],(Account,Receipt,Uint)) => raise AssertionError

properties.text: Recursive patricialize calls strictly increase level parameter, ensuring termination.
properties.assertion: forall call: patricialize(obj, level) => recursive_call uses level' > level

properties.text: encode_node requires storage_root parameter when encoding Account-type nodes.
properties.assertion: pre(encode_node(node)): isinstance(node, Account) => storage_root is not None

properties.text: patricialize input obj must have keys with length > level for branch node construction.
properties.assertion: pre(patricialize(obj,level)): forall key in obj: len(key) >= level

properties.text: After trie_set with non-default value, trie_get returns that value for the same key.
properties.assertion: post(trie_set(t,k,v)): v != t.default => trie_get(t,k) == v

properties.text: After trie_set with default value, trie_get returns default for that key.
properties.assertion: post(trie_set(t,k,t.default)): trie_get(t,k) == t.default

properties.text: root() output is deterministic: same trie._data produces identical 32-byte root hash.
properties.assertion: post(root(t)): t1._data == t2._data => root(t1) == root(t2) AND len(result)==32

properties.text: P2P-delivered block data is fully validated before trie state modification.
properties.assertion: asm: forall block from P2P: validate(block) == true before trie_set operations

properties.text: Engine API is JWT-authenticated; unauthenticated callers cannot trigger state trie modifications.
properties.assertion: asm: forall caller: engineAPI.call(caller) => caller.hasValidJWT == true

properties.text: Remote peers can send arbitrary data; all P2P input to trie operations must be validated.
properties.assertion: asm: forall msg from RemotePeer: trie_affecting_op(msg) => fully_validated(msg) == true

properties.text: Tampered RLP encoding in trie nodes produces different state root, detectable by peers.
properties.assertion: forall node: tamper(rlp.encode(node)) => root(trie_with_tampered) != root(trie_original)

properties.text: Pathological key distributions must not cause unbounded recursion depth in patricialize.
properties.assertion: forall obj: max_recursion_depth(patricialize(obj,0)) <= 2*max_key_length_in_nibbles

properties.text: State root mismatch between nodes causes consensus disagreement; trie must be deterministic.
properties.assertion: forall n1,n2: n1.trie._data == n2.trie._data => n1.root() == n2.root()

properties.text: bytes_to_nibble_list and nibble_list_to_compact are inverse operations (modulo compact header).
properties.assertion: forall b: nibble_list_to_compact(bytes_to_nibble_list(b), false)[1:] roundtrips to b

properties.text: trie_set must not corrupt other keys; setting key k preserves all values at keys != k.
properties.assertion: forall t,k,v,k2: k2!=k => trie_get(trie_set(t,k,v),k2) == trie_get(t,k2)
